buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Authorised Service Centre within the state of Odisha, along with a dedicated contact person with telephone number for technical solution in a fast track basis at this institution as and when required basis. 2. Experience Certificate for the supply of the same to any Govt/ PSU/ any renowned private organisation along with Supply/ Purchase Order. 3. If the agency is registered under MSME or NSIC, then EMD exemption certificate needs to be enclosed. 4. Make in india specific authorisation certificate needs to be enclosed. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical Specifications 1. MHC Class-1 9 mer epitope Net weight: 5 mg each Total Amino Acid: 360 Purity: >98% Number of Peptide: 40 2. MHC class II epitope (14/15mer) Net weight: 5 mg each Total Amino Acid: 505 Purity: >98% Number of Peptide: 35 Terms and Conditions 1. Peptide synthesis: All peptides shall be chemically synthesized using an established solid-phase peptide synthesis (SPPS) or equivalent validated method. 2. Purity: Each peptide shall have HPLC/UPLC-assessed purity of strictly greater than 98%. The purity of ind ividual peptides shall not be established solely from a pooled or representative sample. 3. Identity confirmation: The molecular identity of each peptide shall be confirmed by mass spectrometry, such as MALDI-TOF-MS or LC-MS. 4. Sequence accuracy: Peptide sequences, amino acid length and quantity must conform exactly to the se

quence list supplied by the purchaser. Substitution, deletion, insertion or unintended modification of amino acid residues shall not be acceptable. 5. Net weight: Each peptide shall be supplied in a quantity of 5 mg net peptide content, excluding the weig ht of the vial, counterion, excipients and packaging. The supplier shall clearly declare the basis of the repo rted peptide content and any counterion or salt form. 6. The bidder shall provide the solubility details for each peptide, including the recommended solvent(s) an d any specific conditions required for dissolution. 7. Modifications: No additional modifications, tags, fluorescent labels, terminal modifications, or conjugatio ns shall be introduced unless explicitly specified in the approved peptide sequence list or approved by the end user in writing. 8. Packaging: Each peptide shall be supplied in a separate, sealed, clearly labelled vial. The label shall incl ude peptide identification code, amino acid sequence, net quantity, purity, batch/lot number and storage c onditions. 9. Documentation: The supplier shall provide a Certificate of Analysis (CoA) for each peptide, including the sequence, purity, analytical method, identity confirmation and batch/lot details. 10. Storage and transportation: Peptides shall be packed in suitable moisture-resistant containers and tran sported under the manufacturer's recommended conditions to preserve stability and quality. 11. Research-grade suitability: The peptides shall be suitable for laboratory research and immunological st udies. Clinical, diagnostic or therapeutic-grade certification is not required unless separately specified by t he purchaser. 12. Rejection and Replacement: Peptides that fail to meet the approved specifications, are incorrectly synt hesised or labelled, are deficient in net quantity, or do not meet the specified purity requirements may be rejected. The service provider shall replace such peptides with compliant material at no additional cost to the purchaser, including applicable transportation and handling charges, within the period stipulated by th e purchaser. 13. Failure to Comply: In the event of failure to supply the specified peptides, material non-compliance, or breach of contractual obligations, the purchaser may take appropriate action in accordance with the purch ase order and applicable GeM provisions. Kindly upload GFR144xi compliance certificate as per order F. No. 6/18/2019-PPD dated 23 July 2020 from DoE, Ministry of Finance, PPD, Government of India, in firm’s letterhead, dul y signed by authorised signatory. (‘Format given in the Buyer uploaded ATC document’). Kindly upload a certificate for local content as per ‘preference to “Make-in-India” order No. P45021/2/2017-PPE-11 dated 16- Sep- 2020, issued by DIIPT, Ministry of Commerce and In dustry, Govt. of India, in firm’s letterhead duly signed by authorised signatory. Kindly upload Bid Security Declaration (in-lieu of EMD) in firm’s letterhead, duly signed by a uthorised signatory. (Format given in the “Buyer uploaded ATC document”). .
